Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg_qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 18 s. 2022 MAR 25 2022 HON. VICTOR J. YU Governor Zamboanga del Sur Dear Governor Yu: This has reference to your letter regarding the letters from GlobalTech Mobile Online Corporation concerning the following: (1) Introduction of Peryahan ng Bayan within the Province of Zamboanga del Sur, and (2) Reiteration of the Formal Notice of the Final and Executory Consolidated Decision/Order dated July 19, 2019 of the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 157, Pasig City, finding respondents Officers of Philippine National Police (PNP) Mandaue City, National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) agents of Dagupan City, and PCSO Officials finding the enforcement actions of the respondents against the Peryahan ng Bayan Games as Contumacious or Contemptuous in the consolidated indirect contempt cases under Docket Nos. R-PSG-19-00613-SC to 00621 -SC, 00935-SC, and 00965. Apropos thereto, you requested this Office to clarify if GlobalTech Mobile Online Corporation is authorized to operate, in relation to the suspension order issued on February 6, 2020 by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) pursuant to the Memorandum of the Executive Secretary, and the recall order of the Regional Trial Court 161 , Pasig City of the writ of Execution on the Status Quo Ante Order. It may be recalled that in a Memorandum dated January 29, 2020, issued by Executive Secretary Salvador Medialdea to PCSO, it was clarified that the resumption of peryahan games operation is still suspended. By virtue of said Memorandum, PCSO filed an Urgent Manifestation with RTC Branch 161 stating that the resumption of the operation of the peryahan ng bayan games does not bear the approval of the President and is therefore subject to the suspension order of PCSO Games. Also, on February 5, 2020, the PCSO, through its General Manager Royina Marza Garma, suspended the operation of peryahan games, effective February 6, 2020 until further notice from the Office of the President. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

In resolving the Urgent Manifestation of PCSO, Judge Nicanor A. Manalo of RTC Branch 161 in an order dated February 18, 2020 pronounced, "the court takes notice of the aforequoted memorandum from the Office of the President and as such the instant Urgent Manifestation is duly noted and the Writ of Execution dated Januaty 24, 2020 is recalled. " The order of Judge Manalo recalling the Writ of Execution of the Status Quo Ante Order was considered by GlobalTech, in their letter addressed to you, as not only highly irregular but more importantly in violation of the sacred provisions of the Constitution on the principle of separation of powers and/or principle of check and balance. Hence, null and void. In response to your request, this Office take notice of the order of Judge Manalo. Unless otherwise the said order is overturned by the same court or court of higher jurisdiction, the recall order is effective and should be implemented. Any objection of GlobalTech on the said order should be filed in the proper forum. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Very respectfully yours, E AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARL AN for Local Government OSEC/EMNLLLS-LRALLD/rjWOD/1.JSLG/anor Page 2 of 2
